svg.title: stackwrench check on the bundled synthetic demo repository
svg.desc: Illustrative terminal output of stackwrench check on examples/check: a Compose variable that only exists in env_file, an empty string hiding an env_file value, a pass-through variable set nowhere, podman-compose healthcheck gate risks, an override that adds a second published port, a build context that sends node_modules and .env, COPY . . before npm install, a devcontainer.json Dockerfile path resolved from the wrong folder and a missing bind source, node 20 in the Dockerfile against node 22 in mise.toml, Taskfile sources and fingerprint gaps, and a justfile recipe that depends on a misspelled recipe. Hand-drawn in the format of the check command, long lines shortened; not a recording.
svg.text: examples/check — synthetic demo repository, read-only · illustrative, long lines shortened
